fields.title: Spotify artist analytics record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of Spotify's public artist metrics, plus growth deltas computed against the previous run. One ARTIST row per artist, optional TOP_TRACK rows, ERROR rows on failure. Spotify adds and removes fields without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The URL or name that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: pathfinder-queryArtistOverview, pathfinder-searchSuggestions, or none on failure rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: not_found or fetch_failed.

artistName.title: Artist
artistName.description: Artist name as Spotify shows it.

monthlyListeners.title: Monthly listeners
monthlyListeners.description: Unique listeners in the last 28 days, the headline number on a Spotify artist page.

listenersPerFollower.title: Listeners per follower
listenersPerFollower.description: Monthly listeners divided by followers. A high ratio means reach that has not converted into a following yet.

worldRank.title: World rank
worldRank.description: Spotify's global artist rank, or null for the great majority of artists who are not in the published ranking. Spotify sends 0 for unranked; that is normalised to null here so it cannot read as first place.

topCities.title: Top cities
topCities.description: The five cities with the most listeners: city, country, region and listener count.

topCityNames.title: Top city names
topCityNames.description: Just the city names, in Spotify's own order.

listenersInTopCities.title: Listeners in top cities
listenersInTopCities.description: Sum of the five city listener counts.

monthlyListenersPrevious.title: Monthly listeners (previous run)
monthlyListenersPrevious.description: The reading this run was compared against.

monthlyListenersChange.title: Monthly listeners change
monthlyListenersChange.description: Absolute change since the previous reading.

monthlyListenersChangePercent.title: Monthly listeners change (%)
monthlyListenersChangePercent.description: Percentage change since the previous reading.

monthlyListenersChangePerDay.title: Monthly listeners change per day
monthlyListenersChangePerDay.description: Change normalised by elapsed days, so readings taken at different intervals are comparable. Only present when at least half a day separates the readings.

followersChange.title: Followers change
followersChange.description: Absolute follower change since the previous reading.

trend.title: Trend
trend.description: up, down or flat, based on the monthly listener change.

isFirstReading.title: First reading
isFirstReading.description: True when there was no previous reading to compare against.

previousReadingAt.title: Previous reading at
previousReadingAt.description: UTC timestamp of the reading this one was compared against.

daysSincePreviousReading.title: Days since previous reading
daysSincePreviousReading.description: Elapsed days between the two readings.

topTrackPlaycount.title: Top track play count
topTrackPlaycount.description: Lifetime streams of that track. Spotify's official API never publishes this.

topTracksTotalPlaycount.title: Top 10 total play count
topTracksTotalPlaycount.description: Combined lifetime streams across the ten listed top tracks.

topTracks.title: Top tracks
topTracks.description: The ten most-played tracks, each with rank, play count, duration and links.

albumCount.title: Albums
albumCount.description: Number of albums in the artist's discography.

singleCount.title: Singles and EPs
singleCount.description: Number of singles and EPs in the artist's discography.

compilationCount.title: Compilations
compilationCount.description: Number of compilations in the artist's discography.

latestReleaseName.title: Latest release
latestReleaseName.description: Most recent release across albums, singles and compilations.

latestReleaseDate.title: Latest release date
latestReleaseDate.description: Release date of that title. Spotify sometimes only publishes the year, in which case that is what appears.

discoveredOnPlaylists.title: Discovered on
discoveredOnPlaylists.description: Playlists Spotify says are bringing the artist new listeners, with owner and follower-facing links.

discoveredOnCount.title: Discovery playlist count
discoveredOnCount.description: How many such playlists Spotify returned, after dropping the placeholder entries it pads the list with.

featuredInPlaylists.title: Featured in
featuredInPlaylists.description: Spotify playlists that feature the artist, including its own This Is series.

relatedArtists.title: Related artists
relatedArtists.description: Artists Spotify considers similar, with ids and links.

relatedArtistNames.title: Related artist names
relatedArtistNames.description: Just the names, for quick scanning.

upcomingConcerts.title: Upcoming concerts
upcomingConcerts.description: Dates Spotify lists for the artist: title, start time, city, venue and whether it is a festival.

upcomingConcertCount.title: Upcoming concert count
upcomingConcertCount.description: How many upcoming dates were listed.

socialLinks.title: Social links
socialLinks.description: The artist's own Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, TikTok, YouTube and Wikipedia links, as published on their Spotify page.

headerImage.title: Header image
headerImage.description: Largest artist page banner Spotify offers.

rank.title: Track rank
rank.description: TOP_TRACK rows: 1-10 position among the artist's most-played tracks.

playcount.title: Play count
playcount.description: TOP_TRACK rows: lifetime streams for that recording.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: TOP_TRACK rows: track length as m:ss.

trackUrl.title: Track URL
trackUrl.description: TOP_TRACK rows: open.spotify.com link to the track.
